name: Rust 1.99.0
body: ## Language - [Add allow-by-default `raw_borrows_via_references` lint that checks for references that decay immediately into raw borrows](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/138230) - [Extend `unconditional_panic` lint to function calls that panic when the chunks/windows size is zero](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/153563) - [Stabilize C-variadic function definitions](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155697) - [Stabilize the ability to use `#[unsafe(naked)]` functions to define C-variadic functions (`#![feature(c_variadic_naked_functions)]`).](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159746) - [Trait methods are now resolved on an adjusted never type (producing a FCW)](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/156047) - [Coerce from inference variables to trait objects if the inference variable is related via subtyping to a type that is known to be `Sized`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157820) - [Stabilize `#[my_macro] mod foo;`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157857). This allows outlined modules (`mod foo;`) anywhere in the body of a custom attribute or derive macro. - [Fix the `overflowing_literals` lint with repeated negation](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158302). For instance, it will now no longer lint on `--128_i8`, which is already detected by the `arithmetic_overflow` lint. - [Add POSIX symbols to the `invalid_runtime_symbol_definitions` and `suspicious_runtime_symbol_definitions` lints](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158522) - [Lint unused `#[path]` attributes on inline modules](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158835) - [Enable `unreachable_cfg_select_predicates` lint as part of `unused` lint group](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159179) - [Stabilize passing 128-bit integers via vector registers with `asm!` on x86](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159525) - [Explicitly document that some allocations are allowed to grow in-place (but none are allowed to shrink)](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159729) - We now [guarantee](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159730) that the contents of an `UnsafeCell` can be accessed without going through `get` - [The `invalid_reference_casting` lint was adjusted accordingly](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159960) - [Account for globally enabled target features in `global_asm!`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160594) - [Warn if an invalid `doc` attribute is used on a macro invocation](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161003) ## Compiler - [Convert `-Ctarget-cpu` into a target-modifier for AVR, AMDGCN and NVPTX](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/150732) - [Enable `static_position_independent_executables` on all gnu targets](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158510) - When providing a suggestion about a missing method, rustc now prefers an exactly matching name from a [doc alias attribute](https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustdoc/advanced-features.html#add-aliases-for-an-item-in-documentation-search) over a similarity search from other method names. If your new users sometimes expect a method under a different name, adding a doc alias will now help them find it via rustc suggestions, in addition to helping them find it via rustdoc search: [When suggesting method names, prefer *exact* doc aliases over similar names](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160369) ## Platform Support - [Promote `riscv64-unknown-linux-musl` to Tier 2 with host tools](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158766) Refer to Rust's [platform support page](https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustc/platform-support.html) for more information on Rust's tiered platform support. ## Libraries - Iteration on `RangeInclusive` (`a..=b` ranges) is now [optimized better in some circumstances](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155114). As a side effect of this, the behavior of `RangeInclusive` values that has already been exhausted (as an iterator) has changed. For example, the return values of `start()` and `end()` on such ranges may return different values, and using such ranges as slice indexes may have different behavior. These behaviors were not guaranteed to be stable, so these changes are considered to not be breaking changes. - [Relax `transmute_copy` to accept `?Sized` types](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155989) - [Update `transmute_copy` to use a non-unwinding panic](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155989) - [Don't escape U+FF9E and U+FF9F in `escape_debug_ext`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158057) - [Re-export `core::fmt::NumBuffer` in `alloc` (and `std`)](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161430) ## Stabilized APIs - [`IntoIterator` for `Box<[T; N]>`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/iter/trait.IntoIterator.html#impl-IntoIterator-for-Box%3C%5BT;+N%5D,+A%3E) - [`IntoIterator` for `&Box<[T; N]>`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/iter/trait.IntoIterator.html#impl-IntoIterator-for-%26Box%3C%5BT;+N%5D,+A%3E) - [`IntoIterator` for `&mut Box<[T; N]>`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/iter/trait.IntoIterator.html#impl-IntoIterator-for-%26mut+Box%3C%5BT;+N%5D,+A%3E) - [`VecDeque::retain_back`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/collections/struct.VecDeque.html#method.retain_back) - [`core::ffi::VaList`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/core/ffi/struct.VaList.html) - [`Box::into_non_null`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/boxed/struct.Box.html#method.into_non_null) - [`Box::from_non_null`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/boxed/struct.Box.html#method.from_non_null) - [`Vec::into_parts`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/vec/struct.Vec.html#method.into_parts) - [`Vec::from_parts`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/vec/struct.Vec.html#method.from_parts) - [`core::mem::size_of_val_raw`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/core/mem/fn.size_of_val_raw.html) - [`core::mem::align_of_val_raw`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/core/mem/fn.align_of_val_raw.html) - [`core::alloc::Layout::for_value_raw`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/core/alloc/struct.Layout.html#method.for_value_raw) - [`String::from_utf8_lossy_owned`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/string/struct.String.html#method.from_utf8_lossy_owned) - [`string::FromUtf8Error::into_utf8_lossy`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/string/struct.FromUtf8Error.html#method.into_utf8_lossy) - [`FusedIterator for StepBy`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/iter/struct.StepBy.html#impl-FusedIterator-for-StepBy%3CI%3E) - [`std::fs::set_times`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/fs/fn.set_times.html) - [`std::fs::set_times_nofollow`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/fs/fn.set_times_nofollow.html) ## Cargo - Add a new built-in profile `debug`. This is a preparation for transitioning the `dev` profile away from debugging to give a saner default for faster development iterations. Currently there is no difference between `dev` and `debug` profiles. [docs](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/cargo/reference/profiles.html#debug-1) [\#17214](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17214) - Workspace members on edition 2024 or later can now override an inherited workspace dependency's `default-features` field. For example, `serde = { workspace = true, default-features = false }` now turns off default features even when the workspace definition enables them. On earlier editions, `default-features = false` is ignored with a warning. ([RFC 3945](https://github.com/rust-lang/rfcs/pull/3945)) [\#17126](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17126) See also the [full Cargo changelog](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/cargo/CHANGELOG.html#cargo-199-2026-10-01) ## Rustdoc - [Add new `unused_footnote_definition` rustdoc lint](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/137858) - Smarter filtering of trait impls yields performance improvements of 20% on average and up to 40% on some real-world crates. ([1](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159623), [2](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159721), [3](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159779), [4](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159854), [5](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159091)) ## Compatibility Notes - [Fully deprecate the legacy integral modules](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/146882). For example, `std::i32::MAX` should be accessed via `i32::MAX` instead. - [Upgrade `no_mangle_generic_items` into hard error](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/154585) - [The `Pin::new_unchecked` has had its safety invariants changed slightly](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/156935) - [Do not promote references to extern statics](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157641) - [Ensure that the inferred types of `let` patterns typecheck](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157841) - [hermit/fs: Return `unsupported()` instead of `from_raw_os_error(22)`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158247) - [Fixed a bug where `#[repr(simd)]` was accidentally allowed on macro invocations on stable Rust](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158523) - [Abort const-eval when there are generics in the type of the value being produced](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159504) - [Attributes not applying to anything are now an error in code blocks in doc comments](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159849) - [`Box::leak`: tell people to avoid unleaking](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160323) - [PowerPC inline ASM: Fix scalar floats being in the wrong vector lane on little endian](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160441) - [Do not take `doc(cfg())` into account when filtering doctests](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159014) - [Infer anonymous lifetimes in the types of associated consts as `'static`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/156508) - Macros that expand to a semicolon now produce a warning lint (`semicolon_in_expressions_from_non_local_macros`) even when the macro comes from another crate. Previously, such warnings only appeared for macros from the same crate, to avoid showing warnings that can't be fixed locally; however, this masked problems, as integration tests from the crate providing the macro get compiled as a separate crate, so tests often wouldn't reveal this issue. If you encounter a lint like this, please make sure to report it to the crate providing the macro so they can fix it; don't just silence it in your own crate. - [`semicolon_in_expressions_from_macros`: Lint on non-local macros too](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159222) - [Split non-local `semicolon_in_expressions_from_macros` into a separate lint](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159700) - In Cargo, incremental compilation is now disabled by default when running in CI. CI is detected via the `CI` environment variable. [\#17220](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17220) ## Internal Changes These changes do not affect any public interfaces of Rust, but they represent significant improvements to the performance or internals of rustc and related tools. - [Update to LLVM 23](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158734)

name: Windows System Audio Helper v1.2.0
body:
Prebuilt Windows system audio helper binary for meeting transcription.

Captures system audio via WASAPI process loopback (exclude mode),
hearing every application on every output device while excluding
OpenWhispr's own audio. Requires Windows 10 2004 or later; older
systems automatically fall back to Chromium display-media loopback.

Automated release candidate build from `main`.\n\n**npm:** `npm install gitnexus@rc`\n**Version:** `1.6.13-rc.60`\n**Target base:** `1.6.13` (rc #60)\n**Source commit (main):** 74a1af71d48c46ae5ab83ed508957a0a18e81953\n**Release commit (versioned tree):** 619cb5052b4b303d1226c02e0474b9ec5bc434f0\n\nRelease candidates are pre-stable builds intended for early testing. Stable releases remain on the `latest` dist-tag.

* Improve MCP startup compatibility and lazy-load CLI commands by @Shockang in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/207

### 🏎️ Performance

* perf(analyze): hold structural relationships out of the JS heap, on by default (#2680) by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2685
* fix(analyzer): reject cross-drive paths in the identity containment guard by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2688
* fix: large-repo analyze OOM and false worker-timeout cascade (#2649) by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2679
* fix: stop misdiagnosing glibc-too-old native loads (#2672) and name the Windows FTS zero-install fix (#2669) by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2689
* perf(communities): fix the O(communities x N) copy in vendored Leiden, wire Icebug to its real API (#2337) by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2692

* fix(trace): add file disambiguator alias by @azizur100389 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2705
* fix(scope-resolution): resolve calls through a closure-valued binding across languages (#2693) by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2695
* fix(ai-context): emit compact markdown tables by @azizur100389 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/2715

name: v0.9.73
body:
- Feature: enum members are now extracted as nodes with `case_of` edges in four more languages — **Rust** enum variants (#3938), **Zig** enum members (#3940), **C++** `enum`/`enum class` enumerators including nested enums (#3939), and **Scala 3** enum cases plus their methods (#3937) — all thanks @rajatnagda45.
- Fix: Java calls to inherited methods and `super.method()` now resolve to the declaring ancestor (walking the `inherits` chain, nearest declaration wins), instead of dangling; an unknown/external or ambiguous ancestor fails closed (#3932, thanks @janwaleed09).
- Fix: semantic extraction warns once when a file exceeds the 20,000-character cap and is truncated, instead of silently dropping the tail (#3923, #3773, thanks @AK-Lmn).
- Feature: Solidity file-level free functions (Solidity 0.7+, declared outside any contract) and their calls are now extracted (#3906, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: VB.NET type/module-qualified calls (`MyModule.DoThing()`, `MyClass.SharedMethod()`) resolve to the target method; value-receiver and `MyBase.` calls fail closed (#3909, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: Astro files are parsed correctly — only the frontmatter and `<script>` blocks are fed to the AST pass (the HTML template no longer produces parse errors), with line numbers preserved (#3902, thanks @Bosken85).
- Fix: the "surprising connections" cross-repo/directory bonus now matches the reason it prints — two files at the scan root no longer falsely score as crossing repos (#3934, thanks @neo1777).
- Fix: under `--exclude-hubs`, a node whose only neighbours are excluded hubs is kept with its hub's community instead of being severed into a singleton; the default path is unchanged (#3933, thanks @neo1777).
- Perf: the Neo4j/FalkorDB `--push` path creates a per-label id index before the node upsert loop, fixing the throughput collapse on large graphs (#3957, thanks @Yi-111-a).
- Fix: community labeling keeps the labels it already named when a nested retry fails to parse, instead of discarding the whole batch (#3956, thanks @Vikram-Lex).
- Fix: `graphify hook status` reports hooks written by an older release as out of date (run `graphify hook install` to refresh) (#3951, #3771, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: a Rust virtual-workspace-root `Cargo.toml` (only `[workspace]`, no `[package]`) is treated as skipped-by-design rather than warned as zero-node (#3930, #3910, thanks @Adityakk9031).
- Fix: when the instructions file (`CLAUDE.md` etc.) is a symlink, install reports the real target it wrote to, and uninstall keeps the symlink (strips only the graphify section) instead of deleting the link (#3950, #3953, #3805, thanks @bercedev).

name: @tauri-apps/cli v3.0.0-alpha.4
body:
## [3.0.0-alpha.4]

### New Features

- [`49dc7cc39`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/49dc7cc39017f63b81adb09303d9b82d5b71207a) `tauri migrate` now migrates Tauri v2 apps to v3 (v1 and v2 beta apps continue to v3 after their existing migration):
    
    - The Tauri crates and official plugins are updated to v3 in `Cargo.toml` and `package.json`, and the app depends on `tauri-runtime-wry`, which receives the `devtools`, `unstable`, `tracing`, `x11`, `dbus` and `macos-proxy` features (including the ones enabled through the app's own `[features]`). The removed `wry`, `macos-private-api` and `objc-exception` features are dropped.
    - The `app > macOSPrivateApi` option is removed and the NSIS `install-icon` key is renamed to `installer-icon` in the main and platform-specific configuration files, keeping their formatting and comments.
    - The Rust sources select the runtime with `.runtime(tauri_runtime_wry::Wry::default())` on `tauri::Builder::default()`, use `tauri::DynRuntime` instead of `tauri::Wry`, and pick up the renamed `with_inner_blocking`, `initialization_script`, `run_invoke_handler`, `tauri_runtime_wry::{tao, wry, android_binding, webview_version}` APIs.

### Dependencies

- Upgraded to `tauri-cli@3.0.0-alpha.4`

### Breaking Changes

- [`b9a77ebb8`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/b9a77ebb8ab57480a354ec47aa45c6898ec9bfda) Removed the `macos-private-api` Cargo feature and the `app > macOSPrivateApi` configuration option. Window transparency and the `fullScreenEnabled` preference no longer rely on macOS private APIs, so they are always available.

name: cua-driver-rs: v0.31.0
body:
# Cua Driver 0.31.0

## Summary

This release includes 11 fixes.

## Fixes

- allow Hyprland foreground typing with Num Lock and keymap options. ([#3970](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/3970)) Thanks @osamahbeig, @spencerbull.
- ship the Hyprland plugin keyboard sources in release kits and test them in CI. ([#4310](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4310))
- wait for a launching macOS app before its first snapshot. ([#4309](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4309))
- report live running state for accessory apps. ([#3456](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/3456)) Thanks @xronocode.
- honor modifiers during X11 drags. ([#3618](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/3618)) Thanks @usedhonda.
- accept every Enter-key spelling in the Linux terminal gate. ([#3658](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/3658)) Thanks @bennybuoy.
- send a real key repeat rate on Hyprland agent keyboards. ([#4358](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4358))
- keep the Windows autostart task when an isolated install or failed registration would remove it. ([#4284](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4284)) Thanks @dajiaohuang.
- report native Wayland modified-drag refusals with a stable code. ([#4360](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4360))
- reveal the agent cursor for keyboard-first actions. ([#4287](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4287))
- resolve element tokens against a snapshot store invalidated on read. ([#3873](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/3873)) Thanks @r33drichards, @injaneity.

## Contributors

Thanks to @bennybuoy, @dajiaohuang, @injaneity, @osamahbeig, @r33drichards, @spencerbull, @usedhonda, @xronocode for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

name: v1.4.218
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This patch is built from the September 29 daily build plus fixes picked from main. Pull requests that landed on main after that are not in this build.

## The short version

**Codex terminals:** Settings → Agents has a new **"Run each Codex terminal on its own server"** switch. It's on by default, which keeps agent status and closing tabs working correctly. Turn it off to go back to Codex's shared server and its agents overview. The switch applies to new terminals. A one-time notice explains the change and links to the switch. Codex started from a cmd.exe tab, by its full path, or after "wait for setup" finishes now runs on its own server too. A busy Codex 0.150–0.157 tab no longer shows as idle, and orchestration workers wait out Codex 0.157's startup screen before their brief is typed.

**More agents:** DeepSeek Harness, Freebuff, Qoder, and CodeBuddy are built in: you can launch them from Orca, and their status shows in the sidebar. ZCode CLI conversations appear in session history, and its Coding Plan quota shows in usage.

**Terminal:** A new **Reset Terminal** item in the terminal's right-click menu clears keyboard and mouse modes a crashed program left on. Orca no longer switches those modes off just because it guessed a program had died, so Shift+Enter and Option/Alt keys keep working in Codex and Claude Code after Ctrl+C. SSH terminals now clean up after a crashed program the same way local ones do. Having hundreds of terminals open no longer stops their output, and a failed terminal save no longer claims your disk is full.

**Orca mobile app:** On Windows hosts, phone swipes in a Codex terminal scroll again instead of typing junk into Codex after the desktop app restarts. If you update with terminals open, this takes effect once Orca's background terminal service restarts: after you close all terminals or reboot. The app also tells you when a newer version is available to install, and the keyboard now covers the page like it does on other screens in the app.

**Browser:** If a page in Orca's browser crashes, resizing its viewport no longer crashes Orca. The chosen size is applied when the page loads again. Browser tabs that are moved between groups no longer go blank.

**Native chat (experimental):** Structured chats can run orchestration themselves and receive worker results. Their status, errors, subagents, and stopped turns are now reported more accurately.

**Reliability:** A large diff no longer freezes Orca when many files change at once, and Cmd+J keeps the keyboard in the terminal when a workspace takes a moment to load.

---

## Product experience

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex terminals get a setting to use their own server or Codex's shared one, more Codex launch types run on their own server, and orchestration workers start more reliably.*

* feat(settings): let Codex terminals opt back into Codex's shared server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23929
* fix(terminal): run Orca's cmd.exe, path-named and setup-gated Codex launches without the shared server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23933
* fix(runtime): stop a busy Codex 0.150-0.157 pane reading as tui-idle by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23805
* fix(runtime): wait out Codex 0.157's startup screen, and stop at Codex's startup dialogs, before typing a worker brief by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23745
* fix(runtime): reopen the quiet-foreground tui-idle lane for agents with no other rest signal by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23598
* fix(codex): restored Codex panes on a managed account resume instead of failing with SUN_LEN by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23724
* fix(agent-trust): bound the remaining Codex trust writes a launch waits on by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23380
* fix(codex): index a new account home before bridging history into it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22971
* fix(codex): turning Codex off per agent keeps its hook entry off by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23667
* feat(orchestration): let a structured chat run orchestration as itself by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22568
* feat(orchestration): deliver worker results to a structured chat coordinator by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22631
* fix(terminal-wait): unattended launches report Claude's trust dialog instead of timing out or typing into it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22927
* fix(zcode): wait for composer before first worker dispatch by @Alex-wangyang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23374

### Agents & agent integrations

*DeepSeek Harness, Freebuff, Qoder, and CodeBuddy are built in, ZCode history and quota are shown, and agent launches and hooks are more dependable.*

* feat(agents): add first-class DeepSeek Harness (dsh) support by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22468
* feat(agents): add Freebuff launch and sidebar status support by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23567
* feat: add first-class Qoder CLI support by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23581
* Add CodeBuddy as a built-in coding agent by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23740
* feat(ai-vault): show ZCode CLI session history by @guanbear in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23513
* feat(usage): show ZCode Coding Plan quota on current main by @guanbear in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23520
* fix(opencode): stop OpenCode 2 loading a stale plugin from the retired shared hooks dir by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23500
* fix(opencode): keep OpenCode 2 panes Working across plugin reloads by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23700
* fix(claude): write only the hook events and statusLine the user's Claude accepts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23614
* fix(agent-launch): report a launch that failed before spawning as failed, with its cause by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22913
* fix(agent-launch): move only the requesting client's view to a launched tab by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22914
* Agent launches carry the surface that started them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23697
* feat(analytics): persist local usage session identities by @blaksmatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18759
* perf(usage): persist a scan's analytics session IDs in one write by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23807

### Native chat

*Experimental structured chats report status, errors, subagents, and stopped turns more accurately, and they can run orchestration.*

* fix(native-chat): render the terminal-backed chat through the structured chat's turn status by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22090
* feat(native-chat): Codex sessions write their subagents into the host status store by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22553
* refactor(sidebar): one subagent row for CLI and structured children, shared with the chat strip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22565
* fix(native-chat): a message is accepted, then delivered by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22821
* fix(native-chat): the conversation outlives its agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22835
* fix(native-chat): close only the reopened chat when main closes its tab by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22922
* fix(native-chat): a request that failed reads as failed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22944
* fix(native-chat): say a refused chat write in plain words, and keep it with the write it describes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22999
* fix(native-chat): Stop is there from the moment a message is sent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23026
* Show a resting Claude chat's effort instead of a blank picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23106
* fix(native-chat): the host writes chat failures for a person, with a typed fact beside them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23116
* fix(native-chat): let a multi-question ask record list its questions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23451
* fix(native-chat): a turn a proven crash cut short reads interrupted by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23456
* fix(native-chat): stop killing processes that only inherited a chat's spawn tag by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23460
* fix(codex): the provider supervisor outlives its provider group when stopped by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23466
* fix(claude): run structured Claude under the POSIX provider supervisor by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23476
* fix(native-chat): keep a Codex ask's questions in the order it asked them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23502
* fix(native-chat): a failed Codex turn keeps its failure and "Worked for" by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23514
* fix(codex): a native chat's thread opens on the model the chat chose by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23532
* fix(native-chat): show the "Working for" bar while a turn runs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23537
* fix(claude): withdraw a follow-up queued behind a stopped turn instead of dropping it silently by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23553
* fix(native-chat): keep a turn's bar on the prompt that opened it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23573
* fix(native-chat): a subagent's words are presented as that subagent's, never the parent's by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23605
* fix(native-chat): each chat failure says why in plain words, on the thing that failed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23608
* fix(codex): a message whose turn was stopped before Codex took it is withdrawn, not stuck by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23618
* fix(native-chat): a message Claude folds into its running turn no longer splits the turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23621
* fix(native-chat): stop flashing "still starting" on every chat launch by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23666
* fix(native-chat): group chat rows by the turn that produced them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23671
* fix(native-chat): only Codex's turn completion ends a Codex turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23682
* fix(native-chat): an empty workspace opens the default agent as a chat when chat is the default view by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23693
* fix(native-chat): drop the Codex error path #23682 removed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23801
* fix(native-chat): keep a child turn settling on an error Codex will not retry by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23808

### Terminal

*Reset Terminal clears stuck input modes, Orca no longer switches off a live program's keyboard modes, and terminal saves and restores are more dependable.*

* feat(terminal): add Reset Terminal that clears leftover input modes on the host and pane by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23602
* fix(terminal): stop guessing that apps died and wiping their keyboard modes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23584
* fix(terminal): keep a dead app's input modes recoverable after a refuted proof by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23474
* fix(terminal): clear the Kitty input mirror when a shell is confirmed by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23483
* fix(relay): reset input modes a dead program left on in SSH terminals by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23488
* fix(terminal): let unselected Cmd+C reach apps that own their selection by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23597
* fix(terminal): stop inline-image decoders exhausting the renderer's wasm memory budget by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23499
* fix(terminal): stop misdiagnosing save failures as a full disk by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23708
* Improve PTY device error messages with localization support by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23538
* fix(workspace): a restored workspace paints before its terminals reconnect by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22810
* fix(terminal): retry first-terminal seeding until a decision applies by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22919
* fix(terminal): every explicit terminal close commits through one main transaction by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22929
* fix(terminal): main records every tab close, and seeding reads the records by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22955
* fix(terminal): one intentional-stop register, and per-run spawn and input facts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22989
* fix(terminal): stop a resume note from blanking a live remote agent pane by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23491
* fix(runtime): retire an exited terminal before its stream end by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23492
* fix(terminal): reveal splits while the source pane binds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23692
* fix(terminal): preserve typing while a remote pane reattaches by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23701

### Mobile app & paired clients

*Phone swipes scroll Codex on Windows hosts again, the app tells you when an update is available, and terminal streams and keyboard layout behave better.*

* fix(terminal): restore the mouse format with mouse tracking, so phone swipes don't type into Codex by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23946
* feat(mobile): tell users when a newer app binary is installable by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23755
* feat(mobile): the keyboard covers the page like a native screen, and the shell says its height by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23110
* fix(mobile): native desktop-mode keyboard lift stays on screen; metrics carry the row pitch by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23070
* fix(mobile): the page pushes its terminal frame into the document from RN layout by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23079
* fix(mobile): size a terminal's first subscribe from the document's reported cell box by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23080
* fix(mobile): start AI-button agents through agent.launch, never a bare shell by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22762
* fix(mobile): unsubscribe session tabs by request on the direct connection by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22943
* fix(mobile): release streams whose ready arrives after a replayed cancel by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22945
* fix(runtime): register phone terminal subscriptions when the request arrives by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22948
* fix(mobile): show one review sheet at a time so the review screen never freezes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22951
* fix(runtime): let the phone end a terminal stream by the request that opened it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23006
* fix(runtime): register phone tab-list streams when the request arrives by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23045
* fix(mobile): paired clients re-derive a kept terminal after a cold restore by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23109
* fix(mobile): send typed question answers as structured answers by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23458
* fix(runtime): answer terminal.subscribe at once for a pane the desktop already has mounted by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23512
* fix(mobile): left-align every line of the desktop host card by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23673
* fix(mobile): truncate oversize markdown reads instead of failing them by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23676

### Browser

*A crashed page no longer takes Orca down when resized, and moved browser tabs no longer go blank.*

* fix(browser): a crashed page no longer crashes Orca when its viewport is resized by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23852
* fix(deps): take Electron 43.7.5 so detached webviews stop blanking browser tabs by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23586
* fix(browser): give a tab's identity one owner so viewport presets stop dropping client hints by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23718
* fix(browser): a failed SSH route keeps its card while the host redials by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23465
* fix(browser): restore hover after leaving a mobile viewport preset by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22846
* Browser tab placement review by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23462

### Tabs, sidebar & status bar

*New-tab search ranks results better, Cmd+J keeps terminal focus, and sidebar and status bar layout is tidied up.*

* Tab opening ranking by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23435
* Fix terminal focus when Cmd+J wakes a workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23546

* fix(status-bar): re-measure collapsing levels when only the collapsed width moves by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23773
* fix(setup): remove wait-for-setup helper text by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23799

### Editor, diffs & files

*Large diffs no longer freeze Orca, and Markdown documents are found faster.*

* fix(renderer): stop the modal toast rule from freezing large diffs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23721
* fix: bound combined diff editors and scope chat style invalidation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23725
* fix(editor): preserve combined diff scroll on line focus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23735
* Speed up Markdown document discovery with bundled ripgrep by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23306

### SSH, Git & integrations

*Remote agent settings survive a failed read, partial-clone repositories are identified correctly, and Linear accepts team keys that start with a digit.*

* fix(ssh): don't overwrite remote agent config after a failed read by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22644

* fix(linear): accept team keys that start with a digit by @leilei3167 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23423

### Reliability & performance

*Settings search, agent status updates, and the browser version of Orca do less redundant work.*

* perf: preserve matching General settings sections during search by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23177
* perf: preserve matching Accounts settings sections during search by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23192

* fix(tab-group): measure fallback pane geometry once per tab group, only while visible by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23592
